messages:
Maya (ml-eng): started a small canary for rwd-lite-v1q (4-bit hybrid) — 5% live traffic, shadow on 100%. quick numbers below, need callouts and a fallback rule.
Jon (infra): paste the numbers pls
Maya (ml-eng): overall sample N=20,432. mean latency +7% (baseline 82ms -> 88ms), p99 +60ms (320ms -> 380ms). token cost -23% model side. quality: Rouge-L down 1.8% absolute, hallucination alerts 0.7% (baseline 0.2%). embedding cosine drift negligible.

Priya (applied-ml): thanks. what's the slice breakdown? long-docs / summarization / code? any concentrated regressions?

Maya (ml-eng): breakdown: short Q/A (8k) stable, long-docs (4k) show most of Rouge drop (~3.6% on that slice), multi-turn chat (6k) has a 0.4% hallucination bump. sample artifacts show missing supporting facts sometimes.

Sasha (product): user-visible impact concern: long-docs are high-value. We should not promote without mitigations. Recommend autoscale to previous model on errors. :warning:

Ethan (sre): p99 increase is borderline for SLA. we should also check cold start kv-cache hit rate for this version — maybe quantized weights slower to warm. can we get kv hit and cold-start traces?

Maya (ml-eng): good point — KV warmup metric shows 12% more cold-path hits in first 30s after instance boot. probably due to shorter kv cache budget after quantized loading.

Priya (applied-ml): propose canary gating rules update: keep sample size >=20k, require per-slice delta Rouge-L >= -1.0% and hallucination_delta <= +0.3% for all critical slices. Also require p99 latency delta <= +30ms. If any condition fails, auto-fallback to previous stable model.

Jon (infra): config snippet for rollout automation (for ops):
```yaml
canary: 0.05
min_samples: 20000
per_slice_checks:
  - slice: long-docs
    metric: rouge_l
    max_down: 1.0
  - slice: multi-turn
    metric: hallucination_rate
    max_up: 0.3
latency:
  p99_max_delta_ms: 30
fallback: auto
```

Maya (ml-eng): I ran that offline, and long-docs failed (3.6% down). question: should we allow a conditional rollback that keeps shadowing for additional 24h to see stabilizing trend?

Sasha (product): we can allow 24h additional shadow + remediation runbook only if product sign-off. no promotion until long-docs passes.

Ethan (sre): add a safety net to limit blast radius: max concurrent promoted canaries = 1 and incremental ramp: 5% -> 10% only if 1h stability and no alarms.

Maya (ml-eng): agreed. I'll kick off extended shadow for long-docs slice and run targeted evals (n=5k samples focused on context-length >4k). will post results in 12h.

deploy-bot: rollout job queued: canary 1733331234-rwd-lite-v1q-extend-shadow. monitor at https://console.redwood/rollouts/1733331234

Priya (applied-ml): one more ask — add a lightweight automatic rollback threshold: if hallucination_rate delta > +0.5% OR rouge_l drop > 2.5% across any critical slice within first 4h, trigger immediate rollback.

Jon (infra): noted. i'll add that to the pipeline guard.

Maya (ml-eng): thanks all — will update after the 12h targeted run. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
